title: PNG text chunk carla:capture, format version 1
description: The identity of one still: the simulation frame and time it was rendered at, and the run it belongs to, so a still separated from its sidecar still says which capture it is. This schema describes format version 1; a chunk with no format_version was written before chunks carried one and is version 1.

format_version.description: The chunk's format version. Absent from a chunk written before chunks carried one, which is version 1.

tick.description: The simulation frame the image was rendered on. It pairs the still with its truth sidecar and identifies the same instant across runs.

sim_time_s.description: Simulated time at that frame, seconds.

run_id.description: The run the still belongs to. A recorder always names one; it is left out only when empty.

scenario_id.description: The scenario driving the run, where one is.

seed.description: The seed the run was started with, where one was given.

producer.description: What made the still. Absent from a still written before stills carried it.
What made the file: the tool and its release, the carlanet release, the CARLA server's build identity where a server was used, the SUMO release where SUMO ran, and when the file was written.

tool.description: The component that wrote the file, such as carlacontrol.CaptureSession, or the program's name where no component declared itself; unknown where neither is known.

tool_version.description: The release version of the package the tool comes from; null where the tool did not say.

carlanet.description: The carlanet release that wrote the file: 0.10.0 for a tagged release, 0.10.0+g<commit> for any other build.

server.description: The CARLA server's build identity, where a server was used; null where none was.

sumo.description: The SUMO release, such as 1.27.0, where SUMO ran; null where it did not.

written_utc.description: When the file was written, in UTC to the millisecond.

server.description: What the CARLA server says it was built from.

oneOf.description: A server that answered the build identity call. Each value is the server's own, unknown where it cannot know it.

release.description: The CARLA release the server was compiled with, such as 0.10.0.

world_interface.description: The world interface version the server declares, major.minor, such as 1.0.

build.description: package for a cooked server, editor for one run from the editor.

configuration.description: The build configuration, such as Development or Shipping.

carla_commit.description: The CARLA commit the server was built from.

content_commit.description: The content commit its package was cooked from.

engine_commit.description: The Unreal Engine commit its package was built with.

commits_from.description: Where the commits came from: version_file (the package's VERSION file), compiled (the CARLA commit compiled into the server) or none.

oneOf.description: A server built before the build identity call, with what its other calls said.

available.description: The server did not answer the call.

release.description: The release its version call reported, or unknown.

world_interface.description: The world interface version it reported, or unknown.

reason.description: Why the identity is not available.
